create.name: Jennifer Hadley
create.bio:
Jennifer Hadley is an American minister and teacher of A Course in Miracles, with forgiveness and daily spiritual practice at the centre of her work. She has studied with Michael Bernard Beckwith since 1994, became a licensed Science of Mind practitioner through the Agape International Spiritual Center in 2000 and was ordained there in 2006. Before that she wrote for the stage and screen, co-writing a play staged Off-Broadway and on PBS and taking a master's degree at the film school of the University of Southern California. In 2013 she founded Power of Love Ministry, a non-profit through which she teaches today.

She has taught the Course for more than twenty-five years and has hosted a weekly podcast on it since 2011, now running to hundreds of episodes. Her teaching is practical: noticing the beliefs and habits of mind that keep us stuck, and practising forgiveness until it changes how we live with family, work and money. She runs a year-long programme, Masterful Living, a weekly Sacred Circle where members bring her their questions on Zoom, monthly Deep Dive workshops, Sunday services with friends of the ministry, and a training for spiritual counsellors. Her YouTube channel carries short daily prayers and longer talks on the Course.

courses.title: Masterful Living 2027
courses.description: Her year-long online programme for putting A Course in Miracles into daily practice, working with a group on the beliefs and reactions that keep coming back. Registration for the 2027 year is open.

courses.title: Sacred Circle with Jennifer Hadley
courses.description: A weekly Zoom gathering on Wednesdays where members put their real-life questions to Jennifer and get guidance grounded in spiritual principle. Questions can be sent in ahead, and every session is recorded for members.

courses.title: Deep Dive Workshop Series
courses.description: A monthly online workshop, each on one theme such as trusting intuition, self-acceptance or family forgiveness. Workshops can be booked one at a time or by subscription.

courses.title: Spiritual counselling with Power of Love Ministry
courses.description: One-to-one spiritual counselling sessions from the ministry's trained counsellors, built on Jennifer's teaching, with a training route for people who want to become counsellors themselves.

free_resources.title: A Course in Miracles podcast and Sunday services
free_resources.description: Her free page of recent podcast episodes, blog posts on the Course and replays of the weekly online Sunday service, which anyone can join live.
